requirement: Split long documents into retrieval chunks with a LangChain-like recursive splitter that keeps paragraphs and words intact where possible and overlaps neighbouring chunks.
skeleton: A default separator tuple and a RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter validating size and overlap, recursing through separators, falling back to characters, and merging pieces into overlapping chunks.
caption: A LangChain-style RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter written in plain Python with no imports. The constructor raises ValueError unless chunk_size is positive and chunk_overlap lies in zero up to but excluding chunk_size, and keeps separators defaulting to paragraph, newline, space and the empty string. split_text returns short text as one chunk and blank text as none; otherwise it uses the first separator present, recurses into pieces that are still too long with the finer separators, splits into characters for the empty separator, and merges pieces with the separator into chunks no longer than chunk_size, starting each new chunk from trailing pieces totalling at most chunk_overlap. The fixture asserts blank handling, paragraph preference, greedy word merging, exact overlapped chunks, the character fallback, the size limit on long text and invalid settings.

plan.intent: Prepare documents for a vector index
constraints: chunk_size must be positive and chunk_overlap in [0, chunk_size), else ValueError
Coarser separators are preferred over finer ones
Consecutive chunks share trailing pieces up to chunk_overlap

rationale.teaches: Recurse through separators from coarse to fine, then greedily merge pieces and seed each chunk with a bounded tail of the previous one.
rationale.why: Cutting at fixed offsets splits words and sentences, missing overlap loses context at boundaries, and oversized chunks overflow embedding limits.

ops.docstring: A LangChain-style recursive character text splitter with chunk overlap.

candidates.why_wrong: An overlap equal to chunk_size is accepted and the merge can never make progress.
Every new chunk starts empty, so neighbouring chunks share no overlap context.
Whitespace-only input yields a blank chunk that gets embedded.
A chunk that exactly fills chunk_size is split early into a smaller one.
A single long word is never split into characters and exceeds chunk_size.
